**Feelin' the Same Way** was performed by **Norah Jones** (from her debut album "Come Away with Me," released in 2002).

**Turn Me On**, which Norah Jones also performed (as a live cover), was written by **John D. Loudermilk**. He first recorded and released it in 1961 with Mark Dinning (who had a hit with it as well), making it one of the classic early rock and roll songs.

So the answer is: **John D. Loudermilk** wrote "Turn Me On," and both songs were performed by **Norah Jones**.
